hosts.enableTmuxMonitorDesc: Show this host in the Tmux Monitor and add its tmux actions to the sidebar

use.title: Use Tmux Monitor
use.description: Browse and control tmux sessions, windows and panes on hosts with the monitor enabled.

enable.label: Enable Tmux Monitor
enable.description: Watch and attach to tmux sessions running on this host.

mouseEnabled.label: Enable tmux mouse support
mouseEnabled.description: On (default): tmux handles the mouse (pane clicking, tmux copy mode), a mouse selection stays highlighted and copied until you click, and on Linux and macOS hosts the selection keys are rebound for the whole tmux server until it restarts. Off: select and copy text normally and the wheel scrolls tmux history. Applies the next time you attach.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer a tmux panel next to this host's SSH terminal.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the tmux panel with a terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the tmux panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Tmux panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Tmux panel size
companionSize.description: Width, or height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Tmux panel edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

tmuxMonitor.killSessionBody: All windows and running processes in this session will be terminated. This cannot be undone.

plugin.name: Tmux Monitor
plugin.description: Browse and control tmux sessions, windows and panes across your hosts.
